text:
You need a bilingual virtual assistant who can handle phone, email, and chat support for appointment bookings while staying organized across EMR, CRM, and email marketing tools.

Hi, I’m Mina Castellan. I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, with strong skills in SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. I’m comfortable working in tech-heavy environments and can bring the same attention to detail and structure to client communication, scheduling, and data entry tasks.

For your healthcare startup, I’d focus on making patient communication smooth, accurate, and responsive in both French and English. I understand the importance of a calm, professional tone when speaking with customers about appointments, and I’m comfortable working across multiple systems to keep information consistent and up to date. Since your role involves EMR, CRM, and email marketing software, I can adapt quickly to new tools and keep workflows organized.

One relevant project I’ve completed was Shopify customer segments for Juniper & Ash Home in e-commerce. I built customer segments from Shopify order exports by recency, frequency, and spend, and fed them to the email tool. One result was that the top segment represented 9% of customers and 41% of revenue, and the email revenue increased by 19%. That project required careful data handling, clear segmentation, and reliable coordination with marketing workflows—skills that translate well to managing customer records and supporting booking-related communications.

What I’d bring to your team:
- Bilingual communication in French and English
- Reliable phone, email, and chat support
- Strong organization for scheduling and data entry
- Comfort with EMR, CRM, and email tools
- A detail-oriented, customer-focused approach

I’d be glad to help your team create a professional, efficient experience for your patients from the first message to the confirmed appointment.
